description: 30 hand-authored questions about the fixture log corpus (eval_rag/fixtures.py). Each question has a short canonical answer and a list of `must_mention` facts the answer MUST include to count as correct. Scoring is substring-match (case-insensitive) over the model's answer text. `expected_citation_substrings` are message snippets a cited log should contain to count as a correct citation.

incident_summary.A: Payment gateway (stripe) timeout cascade 12:01-12:06, 23 failed payments, HTTP 504s
incident_summary.B: Auth brute-force: 47 failed logins for user_789 from 203.0.113.42, account locked
incident_summary.C: DB slow query on orders table, fixed by CREATE INDEX ix_orders_user_id ON orders(user_id)
incident_summary.D: api-gateway v2.14.3 deploy caused 500s on /api/v1/products, rolled back to v2.14.2
incident_summary.E: SKU-456 (Blue Widget) out of stock, 11 order failures, restocked with 100 units
